acceptance: The bypass-test allowlist is empty or contains only documented parse/inspect uses with reasons.
Per-area unit tests pass for each PR; make pr-preflight, make comment-policy-check and make typecheck pass on each head.
description: About 20 modules call the vendored SQLGlot directly (tpcdi loader/queries, tpcds c_tools, flightdata queries, tpcds_obt query_conversion, read_primitives variant_contracts, etl scd_processor, schema, validation, scripts/generate_query_docs.py and others). Migrate them to translate_sql_query / translate_ddl / apply_rewrite in three PRs (TPC-DI; TPC-DS/OBT/FlightData/read_primitives; schema/validation/etl/scripts), shrinking the bypass-test allowlist each time. Callers that only parse or inspect (no dialect output) may keep direct use if the bypass test allows it explicitly with a reason.
